entities.name: Marbodius of Rennes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marbodus, Marbod or Marbode of Rennes was archdeacon and schoolmaster at Angers, France, then Bishop of Rennes in Brittany. He was a respected poet, hagiographer, and hymnologist.
